_read_me: Spoilers. The GM console loads this for gm and admin sign-ins only. Edit the lines freely; the times come from Settings (hint_1, hint_2, hint_3, forced_merge).

cues.line: Dispatcher: "Units are fifteen out. Anything on the guests?"
Dispatcher: "We have a name. Ask about the kitchen."
Forced merge — both halves in the same room from here.

reset: Reset the flat: chairs back, drawer closed, note under the lamp.
Both desk devices back to the phone's home screen — the file's own reset, top-left of its lock screen.
Wipe the whiteboard, re-hang the timeline board face down.
Collect the lock and set it to 0000.
Split the next group at the door and read them their half.
Press Start only once the desk half is seated.
